When I finally managed to speak to Dr Bartkiewicz, he had no idea about my diagnosis and responded with "What melanoma?" — an inexcusable lack of awareness and empathy.

Basic responsibilities, like forwarding test results to my oncology team, were not met. I was even warned about the addictiveness of sleeping tablets when I was seeking relief from the anxiety and pain of a terminal illness. That remark alone says everything about the lack of compassion at this practice.

After also witnessing the mishandling of my wife’s recent illness, we have now left the practice. We’ve since learned that we are not alone in experiencing this kind of treatment.
